description: This source file defines CMake functions for string processing, specifically to extract regex matches from strings and replace them. It includes documentation, examples, and two implementations of regex-based string manipulation functions.

methods.name: string_take_regex
methods.description: Extracts a regex match from a string, modifies the string by removing the matched portion, and provides the matched substring.

methods.name: string_take_regex_replace
methods.description: Extracts a regex match from a string, then replaces the matched part with a specified replacement string.
